description: This file declares internal API function prototypes for the Slap Bmc2 Terminal Object within the Service Logic Aggregation Plane (SLAP) of the BroadWay Service Delivery System. It includes function declarations related to object state management and access control.

methods.name: SlapBmc2TermoGetSlapGoaIf
methods.description: Retrieves the interface object for SLAP GOA (Generic Object Abstraction)

methods.name: SlapBmc2TermoGetOlmContainer
methods.description: Retrieves the OLM (Object Lifecycle Management) container associated with the object

methods.name: SlapBmc2TermoReset
methods.description: Resets the internal state of the Bmc2 Terminal object

methods.name: SlapBmc2TermoTerminate
methods.description: Terminates the Bmc2 Terminal object, performing cleanup

methods.name: SlapBmc2TermoEnterDomain
methods.description: Enters a specified domain for the Bmc2 Terminal object

methods.name: SlapBmc2TermoGetUsername
methods.description: Retrieves the username associated with the Bmc2 Terminal object

methods.name: SlapBmc2TermoSetUsername
methods.description: Sets the username for the Bmc2 Terminal object
